title: Recomb Sceptre
summary: Combine +1 fire gems with damage-over-time multiplier; finish with crafted fire damage.
steps: Prepare isolated +1 fire and damage-over-time multiplier donors using Alterations and Augmentations. A fire-gem vendor recipe is another +1 donor route.
Combine the donors with the guide’s blocking crafts. Charge every failed recombination and replacement donor to the budget.
After the desired core survives, add multimod, crafted fire damage-over-time multiplier and fire damage. Account separately for any Harvest enchant.

title: Starter Body Armour
base: Six-linked armour/hybrid body; e.g. Saintly Chainmail
summary: An entry six-link aiming for at least 1,000 armour.
steps: Acquire the six-link first; its purchase price is part of this craft.
Choose Dense Fossil plus a one-socket resonator for the defence route, or an Envy essence route. Repeat to the armour target; these are alternative routes, not simultaneous requirements.
Finish quality and an appropriate available bench craft. Dense excludes life rolls; the essence route does not provide that guarantee.

title: Elder Fire Trap Helmet
base: Elder Archdemon Crown, or an Elder armour helmet, ilvl 82+
summary: Burning Damage and Concentrated Effect supports for socketed Fire Trap.
steps: Acquire the Elder base, or include the Elder influence application in its cost.
Harvest Reforge Fire for both supports. The calculator links below use a specific ilvl 83 Crown and require an open prefix; they reroll blocked outcomes instead of assuming free recovery.
Finish with the selected bench craft. Pohx also describes conditional Exalt, beast and Annul recovery; those branches require their own budget. This target is for Fire Trap, not socketed RF.

title: Elder Righteous Fire Helmet
summary: Horror’s elemental damage modifier, Burning Damage support and life for socketed RF.
steps: Roll Horror until Burning Damage appears; include the guide’s blocked-prefix Exalt attempts when using that branch.
With full suffixes and a free prefix, apply the suffix lock and reforge life. Repeat with a newly paid lock when necessary; a filled item can require recovery or restart.
Finish the AoE bench craft. RF and Fire Trap targets are different; concentrated effect trades away RF radius.

title: RF Gloves
base: Fractured armour gloves; ilvl 84 for resistance, 85 for regeneration
summary: Life, regeneration, dexterity and chaos resistance, with selected Eldritch implicits.
steps: Choose the fracture and desired explicit thresholds before rolling. Envy, Sorrow and Greed are alternatives for different guaranteed modifiers.
Roll the chosen essence until the remaining explicit requirements are satisfied, then fill a useful bench slot.
Roll the selected Exarch and Eater implicits independently. Ignite spread and fire multiplier are different choices; include both implicit-currency budgets, not just essences.

title: RF Boots
base: Fractured boots, preferably regeneration; life/resistance alternatives
summary: Life and regeneration with movement speed and RF-oriented Eldritch implicits.
steps: Choose a fracture and essence route; repeat until the intended explicit combination is present.
Use the available bench slot for the missing movement speed, life or resistance finish.
Roll maximum fire resistance with Embers and the selected regeneration implicit with Ichors. Explicit and implicit retries both belong in the budget.

title: RF Life-on-Block Shield
summary: A block-based RF shield targeting at least 4% life recovered on block.
steps: Use Pristine fossils with resonators, or Harvest Reforge Life, until the recovery modifier meets the chosen threshold.

If needed, convert an elemental resistance to fire, bench life where space permits and fill remaining affixes with Exalts. Extra reservation or maximum-resistance rolls are not guaranteed by this target.

title: RF Totem Shield
summary: Life on block plus an additional totem, using a protected influenced reforge.
steps: Prepare the Shaper shield and roll life on block with the chosen life route.
Fill suffixes if needed and apply a suffix lock while a prefix is available.
The guide’s protected influence reforge consumes 5,000 Primal and one Sacred lifeforce per use. Include lock, filling and any Allflame recovery costs; finish the available bench modifier.

title: RF Rings
base: Fractured Vermillion, Ruby, Two-Stone or Amethyst Ring
summary: A flexible RF ring with life, resistance and damage or dexterity.
steps: Select a useful life, resistance or dexterity fracture and explicit thresholds.
Choose Anger essence or Harvest chaos reforges for the desired combination. Delirium is a distinct, more expensive multiplier route.
Finish a compatible bench modifier and, if chosen, catalysts. Do not assume the optional catalyst investment is free.

title: Starter RF Amulet
base: Fractured amulet ilvl 75+, or 84 for higher resistance tiers
summary: Fire damage and useful life/multiplier stats; compare with buying an existing amulet.
steps: Choose a life, multiplier, damage, dexterity or resistance fracture.
Use Anger essences for the selected outcome. +1 fire is an optional Fire Trap upgrade; it does not scale RF damage.
Bench the missing modifier and add the chosen anoint. Include oils and catalysts in additional costs. Pohx notes that buying a multiplier amulet can be preferable.

title: Elder RF Stygian Vise
summary: Life, regeneration, recovery rate and increased maximum life on an Elder belt.
steps: Acquire the influenced base. Choose exact target tiers before estimating rerolls.
Repeat Pristine fossils and one-socket resonators. The guide’s approximate shopping/attempt figure is not a calibrated probability for every target variant.
Finish the bench modifier and life catalysts; separately budget the abyss jewel when evaluating the whole equipped item.

title: RF Crimson Jewels
summary: Life and damage multipliers; the source currently recommends buying rather than crafting.
steps: Select the precise modifier combination before evaluating a craft. Several useful two-mod outcomes are not equivalent to a premium four-mod jewel.
Harvest life, fire or chaos reforges are alternative routes. Track lifeforce actually allocated to the chosen route.
Compare the result with the same modifier combination on the market. Pohx explicitly prefers buying jewels at the time of this guide.

title: Endgame Recomb Amulet
summary: Recombine +1 fire gems and at least 20% damage-over-time multiplier.
steps: Roll and isolate +1 fire and a high multiplier on separate donors. Count discarded donors and Annuls.
Recombine; repeat preparation after a failed result. Regal the successful magic item.
Choose a simple bench finish or the guide’s conditional suffix-removal route before multimodding. The removal can destroy a desired suffix; it is not a guaranteed finish.

title: RF Cogwork Ring
summary: Fractured Delirium multiplier with fire damage, strong resistances and life.
steps: Roll Delirium and prepare four modifiers for a fracture attempt. Include failed fractures, replacement bases and Allflame bench spending.
After the desired fracture, roll Anger for the resistance target and clear the required slots. A failed Annul returns to the essence stage.
Lock suffixes and reforge chaos; complete suffixes before relying on a Matron lock. Repeat protected life reforges, recover filled prefixes, then finish damage and catalysts.

title: 30% Reservation Shield
base: Shaper armour shield ilvl 84+ and a Hunter reservation donor
summary: Combine life on block and 30% reservation efficiency, then finish life.
steps: Isolate life on block on the Shaper target and reservation efficiency on the Hunter donor; neither may have another influenced modifier.
Use the Awakener’s Orb on the donor first, then on the retained shield. Include donor destruction and failed preparations.
Choose a budget life bench or a protected life-reforge finish. Matron locking needs full suffixes; budget preparation and Allflame recovery for filled prefixes.

title: Endgame Recomb Sceptre
summary: A +2 gem sceptre with damage-over-time multiplier and crafted finishes.
steps: Prepare isolated +1 fire, +1 all spells and multiplier donors. Charge imprints, Annuls and replacement bases where used.
Build separate fire/multiplier and all-spells/multiplier intermediates, then recombine the +2 core. Failed intermediate and final combinations consume separate resources.
After success, apply multimod and the two intended damage crafts. Include the selected Harvest enchant and any elemental conversion.

title: Minmax Recomb Sceptre
summary: A +2 sceptre with both damage-over-time multipliers and a Hunter finish.
steps: Prepare donors for the two gem modifiers and both multipliers, then assemble the two intermediates.
Recombine the four-mod core. The guide’s final-step success estimate is not the probability or cost of the complete multi-stage craft; include recoveries and donor preparation.
Bench fire damage, perform the chosen Allflame-assisted Hunter slam and add a Harvest enchant. A specific premium Hunter outcome needs its own model.

title: Endgame RF Shield
base: Multiple ilvl 86 Shaper Ezomyte Tower Shields
summary: Recombined recovery/reservation suffixes followed by protected life rolling.
steps: Prepare the desired recovery, reservation and third suffix on donors; build two-suffix intermediates and combine them.
Reuse failed outputs only when their surviving modifiers support the next combination. Count every donor, preparation and recombination charge.
With complete suffixes, apply Matron locks and reforge life repeatedly. Budget filled-prefix recovery, optional Divines for recovery value, and the final bench/Exalt finish.

title: Elevated Fire Trap Helmet
base: Elder Archdemon Crown plus a Shaper helmet donor, ilvl 82+
summary: Elevated Burning and Trap/Mine supports with a veiled AoE finish.
steps: Prepare level-20 Burning on the Crown and level-20 Trap/Mine on the donor, each with the extra influence modifier required for elevation. Count failed Dominance attempts and replacement preparations.
Elevate both, then use Awakener on the Shaper donor before the Crown. Recover or fill slots without assuming protected modifiers survive for free.
Lock full suffixes, use Veiled Chaos, block and unveil for +2 AoE; repeat failed finishes with new locks and recovery costs. Bench life. This is a Fire Trap target.

title: Minmax Recomb Fire Trap Helmet
base: Evasion donors, Elder Archdemon Crown and Shaper support donor, ilvl 82+
summary: A multi-donor Horror/support helmet with a recovered Concentrated Effect and veiled AoE finish.
steps: Prepare the Horror evasion donor with non-fractured T9 dexterity and the specified blocking. Apply the cheapest non-Shaper/non-Elder influence orb; the four listed alternatives are not cumulative.
Prepare Burning on the Crown and a sole Trap/Mine influence on the Shaper donor. Use paid Lock previews to accept an Awakener result with at most two prefixes and two suffixes.
Recombine with the Horror donor; account for failures and reusable outcomes. Lock suffixes, clear prefixes, block and Exalt for Concentrated Effect.
Protect and recover the prefix, then use the guide’s Allflame/Veiled Exalt and unveil loop for +2 AoE. Finish life. Follow the linked slot-specific recovery branches before spending.

title: Endgame Righteous Fire Helmet
base: Elder/Shaper armour helmet, ilvl 85+; Giantslayer preferred
summary: Horror and Burning suffixes with an increased-area support prefix for socketed RF.
steps: Combine influences while preserving the selected armour base, then roll Horror for Burning.
Fill the remaining suffix through a chosen branch. With full suffixes, lock, scour prefixes, block armour and Exalt for increased-area support; repeat paid cycles after failure.
Pursue the selected life or Concentrated Effect finish only with its extra costs included. Bench the remaining modifier. This is a socketed-RF target, not the Fire Trap helmet.

title: Minmax Recomb Righteous Fire Helmet
base: Evasion donors, Elder Giantslayer Helmet and Shaper donor, ilvl 82+
summary: Horror/Burning and nearby-enemy elemental damage with a specialised RF prefix finish.
steps: Prepare the Horror evasion donor with non-fractured T9 dexterity and the specified blocking. Apply the cheapest non-Shaper/non-Elder influence orb; the four listed alternatives are not cumulative.
Roll Burning on the Elder target. Use paid Lock previews with the sole-influence Shaper nearby-enemy-damage donor, accepting at most two prefixes and two suffixes.
Recombine with the Horror donor; budget lost or reusable outputs. Lock suffixes, clear prefixes, block and Exalt for an area support.

Use the source’s protected Annul or Dominance recovery before pursuing the second desired prefix. Failures can restart the prefix loop. Finish the compatible bench modifier; charge every repeated lock and recovery.

title: Double-Veiled Mittens
summary: Chaos resistance and regeneration, with a veiled AoE prefix and crafted damage.
steps: Use Envy and the selected Exalt/Annul recovery route for chaos resistance, regeneration and the third desired suffix.
With full suffixes, apply a Matron lock and Veiled Chaos. Recover filled prefixes with the correct Eldritch dominance; losing the veil requires another paid cycle.
Block and unveil AoE/area damage, craft flask-effect damage and roll the chosen Eldritch implicits. Count implicit and unveil retries separately.

title: Endgame RF Boots
summary: Regeneration/resistance suffixes, veiled movement speed and upgraded maximum-fire-resistance implicit.
steps: Build chaos resistance, regeneration and an elemental resistance with Envy and the chosen recovery steps.
Lock full suffixes and use Veiled Chaos. Recover filled prefixes under the correct Eldritch dominance; block before unveiling the chosen movement-speed mod.
Finish the avoidance/bench setup, then roll and upgrade the selected implicits with higher-tier Eldritch currency and Conflict. Charge failed upgrades and required re-rolls.

title: Abyss Socket Mittens
summary: Pohx marks this guide Work in Progress; no procedure or cost model is published.

title: Fractured +2 Amulet
summary: A +2 amulet with a chosen veiled finish; preparation and recovery are conditional.
steps: Buy the fracture or include every self-fracture attempt. Roll +1 all gems, then use paid Lock previews to accept a Regal suffix; reset unsuccessful previews at a cost.
Protect prefixes and remove that suffix. Apply the specified multimod/prefix-lock/fire-attack blocks before Harvest fire add/remove; account for all repeated preparation.
Rebuild protection for the veiled finish. Unwanted unveils can require a lock/scour restart; follow the source’s prefix-versus-suffix branches.
Budget optional level-30 Spider, anoint, catalysts and the final bench craft separately. No success rate for the complete procedure is established here.

title: Recomb +2 Amulet
summary: Recombine all-gem level and multiplier, then add fire-gem level with a protected Harvest setup.
steps: Prepare and isolate all-gem and multiplier donors; combine them using the specified blocking crafts.
Apply multimod, prefix protection and the fire-attack block before Harvest fire add/remove. Losing multiplier requires a separately budgeted recombination recovery.
Remove crafts, finish life and choose the Allflame-assisted Hunter slam. A desired Hunter result is not guaranteed.
Include optional Spider, oils and catalysts. Track replacement donors, locks and recovery attempts rather than pricing only the final surviving item.
